Photographed at Gavins Point National Fish Hatchery in Yankton, SD by Sam Stukel (USFWS).
Quagga mussels (top row) and zebra mussels (bottom row).

Zebra Mussels (Dreissena polymorpha) are a highly invasive species which are commonly spread through ballast water and contaminated recreation equipment. Zebra mussels can also hitchhike on moss balls
